shared_fragments.text: **指回关系与同一规则 / Binding and identity，2026-10-08。** [本轮论证及反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-INTEGRATION.md)区分构成共同指向与经验再辨认；明确语法中无来源、无周围假设的原子型 A → A 项只能返回所给根据。7项新定理／21项含继承审计全空。/ Source-free transport and atomic endomorphism uniqueness are checked, with ambient/source controls. Binding interpretation and full presuppositionless grounding remain open; existing logical-relations work is credited.

**由绑定说明同一 / Identity through binding，2026-10-08。** [第14节](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md#recognitional-binding)推进共同指向的构成性解释，7项新定理／21项含继承审计全空。/ Every closed source-free atomic endomorphism in the supplied language retains its argument; grammar, evaluation and actual correspondence remain explicit. Full grounding and novelty are not claimed.

**指回关系的接续 / Binding continuation，2026-10-08。** [论证、主来源及反审](RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-INTEGRATION.md)以既有语言检查无来源传递、原子恒等唯一性及两个替代；7项新定理／21项含继承审计全空。/ The local structural connection is complete; actual binding and hypothetical substitution remain the foundational bridge.

**Recognitional binding, 8 October 2026.** [RecognitionalBinding.lean](RecognitionalBinding.lean) and [checker](check_recognitional_binding.py) check source-free logical relations, closed atomic identity uniqueness, absence of closed atomic grounds and ambient/source alternatives. Seven new theorem audits plus 14 inherited declaration audits are all empty. The syntax and evaluation remain supplied; [integration](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes the constitutive candidate from full grounding.

**构成共同指向 / Constituted coreference，2026-10-08。** F01成对接入[绑定、唯一性及反审](RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-INTEGRATION.md)，7项新定理／21项含继承审计全空。/ Only the owned F01 suffix and links, five read/authored versions and one discovery page change; concurrent entry text, other rows and pending reviews remain. [Edits](RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-INDEX-EDITS.json); [checks](RECOGNITIONAL-BINDING-CHECKS.json). No whole-table, independent or complete presuppositionless certification.

entry_before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。 第二轮从原生占用规律推出局部历史允许的固定上下文精确判据；单相关支承位摘要保留所选工作负载的执行与整体事件步数预算。 第三轮证明：当前接入相同，允许改接范围内占用一致，当且仅当全部允许有限历史可行性一致。 第四轮将有来源保证的记录与逐位置核对接到同一原生取得过程；任意有限执行投影合法，并保留取得／使用预算。 无预设元逻辑续研提出同一规则的构成性根据候选：同一根据在同一认可要求下直接承接；完整奠基仍待完成。
entry_before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success. A continuation derives the exact frozen-context criterion from native occupancy laws; a relevant-slot summary preserves selected execution and merged-state event-count budgets. A third round proves that, at equal current routes, agreement on permitted-slot occupancy is equivalent to agreement on every allowed finite-word feasibility judgment. A fourth round connects maintained records and per-slot validation to the same native acquisition process, proving finite-trace projection and separate acquisition/use accounting. Direct metalogical inquiry adds a constitutive identity-rule candidate: re-presenting the same ground under the same assessment requirement; full grounding remains unfinished.
entry_before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；第一轮提出的上下文与摘要目标已由本次有范围结果接续。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。 新37项定理／220项闭包审计（124空）；新证明无经典选择。初始完整相容性、局部历史与固定占用条件明示；总量摘要失败，单支承摘要不能认证遗漏位置的相容性。整体预算不等于保持其他占用的准备，步数不等于真实时间。Iris/Leaf已有先例，仍属完成的整合而非新颖性证明。 新24项定理／42项总审计（30空）；原生三步历史产生旧工作负载等价、扩展范围可区分的配置。旧摘要加目的地不足以总能更新摘要。允许范围、原子性和身份给定；不禁止无损编码，未解决新读数取得或确立前沿新颖性。已完成交错研究直接复用。 新28项定理／70项闭包审计（38空）；新证明8空、20仅标准依赖，无经典选择。无关改变可继续；指定n次失效后读取／使用需n+2单位，任意有限预算有耗尽见证。原子可信读取、全部写入版本维护及原子核对／使用给定；此局部连接已完成，现实对应及新颖性未证。 新11项形式审计均为空命名公理报告，仍使用 Lean 元理论。混合认可标准可不反身，反身性不独自保证接续；Curry 型固定点控制限制任意自我担保。实查不代替内容／根据辨认的哲学说明，既有无前提不可能性未证，亦未宣称完成或新逻辑。
entry_before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; the first-round context/abstraction target is continued by the scoped results below. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate. Continuation: 37 new theorems / 220 closure audits (124 empty), no new choice dependency. Full initial compatibility, a valid local history and a frozen frame are explicit. Counts lose readiness; the selected summary loses hidden-slot compatibility. Merged-state budgets do not imply preparation preserving held occupancy, and steps are not physical time. Iris/Leaf precedents remain credited; the scoped integration is complete, without a novelty claim. Reconfiguration: 24 new theorems / 42 total audits (30 empty). A native three-event history witnesses old-workload equivalence and separation under wider access; old active-view plus destination cannot always determine the new view. Permission scope, identities and atomicity remain supplied. Lossless encodings remain possible; observation acquisition and novelty are not established. Completed interleaving work is reused. Acquired-use continuation: 28 new theorems / 70 closure audits (38 empty); new reports are 8 empty and 20 standard only, with no choice. Unrelated change is allowed; n specified invalidation cycles then read/use cost n+2 units, and every finite budget has an exhaustion witness. Coherent atomic reads, full writer revision maintenance and atomic validate/use remain supplied. This local bridge is complete; realization and novelty are not established. Eleven new formal audits have empty named-axiom reports but retain Lean's metatheory. Mixed standards can fail reflexivity; reflexivity alone does not ensure composition. A Curry fixed-point control limits unrestricted self-certification. Formal checks do not establish philosophical recognition of content/ground; neither impossibility, completed presuppositionless grounding nor a new logic is claimed.
